realtime_audio: processed in memory on the runtime; the gateway buffers PCM only for the ONE final consented sample
final_sample: existing DataCollectionService path: organization consent ceiling + per-session contribution-off honored (unit-tested); at most one sample per session, exactly like one batch upload
cancel_or_disconnect: the session dies; buffers are discarded; nothing persists (no final means no collect)
retention: unchanged from the batch policy; no broadening
